options.name: A - two Vercel external rewrites
options.technical: Supported for /client-portal and /admin, including their assets, callbacks and API prefix. Public routes can remain unchanged.
options.cost: No added subscription for technical owner testing, but commercial use requires a permitted Vercel agreement. Current Hobby doesn't provide one.
options.publicWebsite: No source/design change needed. Requires production Vercel routing configuration change, currently unapproved.
options.authentication: Same-origin host-only HttpOnly cookies across both prefixes. Fixed backend origin, Supabase redirects and Turnstile must match www before production acceptance.
options.rollback: Remove the two rewrites or restore previous Vercel deployment.
options.risk: Commercial eligibility unresolved. Rewriting to a free external backend doesn't exempt traffic served by Vercel.

options.name: B - selective Cloudflare ingress
options.technical: Free full-zone proxied ingress can send portal prefixes to Workers and remaining paths to the original Vercel origin. Does not require rebuilding homepage HTML.
options.cost: Cloudflare ingress can use Free, but the retained Vercel commercial origin still needs compliant eligibility. This isn't a verified fully compliant zero-subscription arrangement under the existing constraints.
options.publicWebsite: Original app remains the origin. Public form methods, original assets and responses pass through, without HTML rewriting.
options.dnssec: Requires future separately approved authoritative/proxy setup with DNSSEC transition. No such action is approved or performed tonight. Partial CNAME setup retaining external authority requires Business/Enterprise.
options.authentication: Preserve portal cookies and Origin. Strip Supabase cookies from public-origin forwarding. Fixed backend origin must be configured deliberately. Host-header/canonical redirect and TLS acceptance are still required on the actual hostname.
options.complexity: Higher. DNS, TLS and proxy require separate approval and staged acceptance.
options.rollback: Restore prior route/proxy/delegation with cache-aware plan. Existing Vercel deployment retained.
options.risk: Redirect loops, cache scope, origin binding and DNSSEC transition. Do not deploy the isolated proof as a migration script.

options.name: C - current temporary portal origin
options.technical: Existing Workers static portal and Supabase Edge backend are deployed separately.
options.cost: Uses existing free resources, no added subscription. No Vercel requests for portal traffic.
options.authentication: Verified host-local test-client session. Main-domain cookies are not established by this acceptance.
options.rollback: Previous Worker version, with Supabase backend compatibility review.
options.risk: Doesn't satisfy the requested final company-domain paths.

decision: Retain C for safe engineering. A is the simplest technical path if hosting eligibility and routing approval become available. B preserves the public application but cannot be called a commercial-policy solution while forwarding it from the same ineligible Hobby origin. No option satisfies every current production constraint. Do not spend, seek exceptions again or activate a full-domain migration without a new owner decision.
isolatedProof: platform/routing/selective-ingress.ts is not bound to a hostname. Executed tests verify exact prefix selection, unchanged public response bytes, public API preservation, private cookie separation, no-cache portal responses, redirect pass-through and rejection of self-referencing origins. These are controlled tests, not a claim of live company-domain TLS/authentication acceptance.
